title: [AUG-167] Action items extraction gets starved by text correction under shared Groq rate limit
why_we_need_this: During a live session, LiveTextCorrector (12 s ticks, up to 8 segments) and LiveActionItemsExtractor share one global TextRateLimiter (30 RPM / 6000 TPM). Correction fires more often and eats the budget; action items calls silently get `rate-budget` or `rate-limited` skips. A missed action item is lost forever, while a missed correction is just un-fixed text — action items must have priority.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] When `LiveActionItemsExtractor.tick()` gate opens, the next `LiveTextCorrector.tick()` yields (skips its cycle) so the action items call goes through first
- [ ] After the action items call completes (success or skip), correction resumes normally on its next interval
- [ ] The priority mechanism is a simple flag/signal between the two services, not a change to `TextRateLimiter` itself
- [ ] No new rate limiter instances — the shared singleton stays as-is
- [ ] Logs show `[correction] yielded to action-items` when a correction tick is skipped due to priority
- [ ] Existing tests for LiveTextCorrector and LiveActionItemsExtractor still pass
- [ ] New test: when action items gate is open, correction tick is a no-op; after action items call finishes, correction resumes
important_constraints:
**Architecture (confirmed from code):**
- `server/src/services/groqText.ts:58` — `const limiter = new TextRateLimiter()` is the shared singleton
- `server/src/services/liveTextCorrection.ts` — `LiveTextCorrector`, ticks every 12 s (`LIVE_CORRECTION_INTERVAL_MS`), calls `correctSegments()` → `createGroqTextClient().chat()`
- `server/src/services/liveActionItems.ts` — `LiveActionItemsExtractor`, ticks by gate (word count + time), calls `createGroqTextClient().chat()` via `deps.cloudChat`
- Both are instantiated per live session in `liveTranscription.ts`

**Approach — priority flag:**
1. Export a simple signal from `liveActionItems.ts` (e.g. `actionItemsPending: boolean` or an event) that is set `true` when the gate opens (before the cloud call) and `false` after the call completes/skips
2. In `LiveTextCorrector.tick()`, check the signal at the top — if action items are pending, `return` early (log and skip)
3. Both services belong to the same live session — wire the signal when creating them in `liveTranscription.ts`

**Do NOT:**
- Split the limiter into two instances (breaks the 30 RPM ceiling guarantee)
- Change `TextRateLimiter` API
- Change correction or action items intervals
- Touch `semanticCheck.ts` (batch path, separate concern)
